connections.why: Enzymes are proteins built from the molecules studied first
Cells must copy their contents before dividing
Glucose is the substrate oxidised in respiration
Membrane structure controls exchange and transport
Transport delivers the substances homeostasis regulates
Photosynthesis stores the energy respiration releases
Meiosis generates the variation genetics describes
Inherited variation drives evolutionary trends and speciation
Adaptations are the product of natural selection
Nervous and hormonal coordination achieve homeostasis
Both rely on cell signalling and recognition
Photosynthesis fixes the energy flowing through ecosystems
Enzymes catalyse the reactions of photosynthesis and respiration
